rationale: The focused restart fixture reproduces the exact four-item persisted queue and retains only the legitimate builder and security-review requests. Additional fixtures cover malformed payload rejection, semantic watermark rejection, control-plane preservation, latest coalescing, and lossless restoration of both runs from a dynamically resolved two-run builder burst. Existing semantic-boundary and latest-200 replay suites remain green, so startup now matches live admission and distinctness without widening reviewer routing.
